prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean a spray (airbrush/mist) tan or UV tanning beds? Or do you want a mobile spray tech who will come to you? If you tell me which part of Charlotte you’re in (Uptown, SouthPark, Ballantyne, Plaza Midwood, etc.) and your preference, I can give a short list of top-rated salons and pros/cons for each.

Meanwhile, quick tips to pick the best salon:
- For spray tans: look for certified technicians and systems like VersaSpa or Mystic (consistent results), check before/after photos and recent reviews for natural color and even application. Ask what solution brands they use and whether they tailor shade to your skin tone.
- For UV tanning: confirm the beds are well-maintained, ask the age/wattage of bulbs, and that staff assess your skin type and exposures. Remember UV tanning carries skin-cancer risk; limit sessions and use protection.
- Read recent online reviews (last 6–12 months), check for cleanliness, friendly staff, and consistent color results.
- Ask about patch tests if you have sensitive skin and about removal/adjustment options for a bad tan.
- Compare pricing and packages (single session vs. membership or multi-tan packages).

If you want, tell me your neighborhood and whether you prefer spray or UV, and I’ll pull together recommended salons and contact details.
